cs.t: i use apple pro keyboard (the one which has 2 usb slots) on ubuntu i dropped it like maybe 100 times for the past 3 years or so, it breaks but none of the button breaks.  it's easy to reattach loose button to keyboard (yes, even the space-bar) it's always wise to invest on keyboard, you are practically married to it ... just don't buy new (mine's used, bought like Sing$10) if you're opposed to buying used, think about it ... you test the used kb, find it's usable, nothing breaks ... what that tells you? ... the used kb has stood the test of time and abuse for years ... then marry her
